text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thus, my three-year schedule is now
complete.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have awoken right on schedule. Next
is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon, you are sliding off your futon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...An eighteen-second delay. I should
factor this
into my schedule soon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I must prepare with haste. For today is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Of course. That is my aesthetic.
choice_data_list: Right on time today as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's important to maintain one's schedule
under
any circumstances so that they
may produce
perfect results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And I am in pursuit of that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A five-second delay has occurred.
Trainer, let's
get our session underway at
once.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you
today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am currently creating a schedule for
the future.
As for when we will reach the
end of my plan...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's just forge ahead together with that
as an
unknown, Trainer.
